attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Start playing on load (subject to browser autoplay policy)

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Single track: sets the native audio.loop. Playlist: wrap to the first track after the last; with shuffle, start a new shuffle cycle

attributes.name: shuffle
attributes.description: Advance to a random track: each track plays once per cycle, never twice in a row. Without loop, playback stops at the end of the cycle

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Reflected playback state, set by the component

attributes.name: muted
attributes.description: Reflects the inner audio.muted (set by the mute button, the M shortcut or script)

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: "error" when the audio (or every <source>) fails to load; a visible, politely announced message is shown. Cleared when a source loads

properties.name: src
properties.description: Get/set the inner <audio> source. Setting loads it, refreshes the title, moves data-audio-active to a matching track link and fires audio-player:src-changed

events.name: audio-player:ended
events.description: A track played to the end

events.name: audio-player:track-change
events.description: A playlist track was activated (click or auto-advance)

childAttributes.name: controls
childAttributes.description: Native controls for the no-JS fallback. Removed while the component is upgraded, restored when it disconnects

childAttributes.name: data-audio-active
childAttributes.description: The loaded track. Author sets the initial one; the component moves it and keeps it on a track after it ends

childAttributes.name: data-audio-played
childAttributes.description: Set by the component when the track plays to the end

structure.description: The native audio element (light DOM); the component renders custom controls for it
Optional playlist (usually inside <details>): one <li> per track with an <a href> to the file

cssProperties.name: --audio-player-accent
cssProperties.description: Play button, slider thumbs and progress fill colour

cssProperties.name: --audio-player-bg
cssProperties.description: Player background and slider thumb border

cssProperties.name: --audio-player-text
cssProperties.description: Track title and controls text colour

cssProperties.name: --audio-player-border
cssProperties.description: Player border and slider track colour
